# requires: transfer
#
# An owner died between a pause being asked for and the pause being carried out.
# The record is left RUNNING under a lapsed lease with want=pause, and the next
# owner's first act must be to honour what was asked rather than to move bytes.
#
# The two halves only work as a pair: a sweep that will not offer the record
# makes the state permanent, and a runner that adopts it and downloads anyway
# restarts work a person deliberately stopped.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=file
claim A alpha 400
intent A pause
sleep 900
orphans
run A beta
state A

# expect 5: ok A [JOB-I12]
# expect 6: ok state=pending [DL-R27]
# expect 6: want=pause done=0 [JOB-I8] [DL-R25]
# expect 7: state=pending
